professionalSummary.text: Runs the cross-team programme plan for migrating internal services to the new orchestration platform.
professionalSummary.witness: Technical program manager at Strata Ledger (accounting software), September 2021 to present, running the plan for moving 120 internal services from the legacy job scheduler to the new orchestration platform in six waves.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the programme's risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (RAID) log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the programme RAID log, reviewing open risks and dependencies with the service owners every Tuesday and closing items only once the owning team had confirmed them.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Coordinates migration readiness reviews with service owners, security and support.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Ran readiness reviews for each migration wave with the service owners, the security team and customer support, using a checklist that covered rollback, alerting and support handover.

skills.text: Publishes a weekly programme status report.
skills.witness: Published the weekly programme status report (waves completed, services blocked, top risks) to the engineering directors' mailing list, with a short section on any wave whose date had moved since the previous week.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in running a migration plan, maintaining a RAID log, coordinating readiness reviews, and publishing weekly reports. They do not establish the candidate's ability to represent the programme to senior leadership or handle director-level escalations.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience aligns with the role's requirements, but further human review is required to assess the full scope of their capabilities.
